subject.title: Prune completed Codex Responses tool replay

question: Should native Codex Responses preserve completed tool-call/output pairs as current transcript policy specifies, or should maintainers approve a narrower documented exception for a verified backend rejection?
rationale: The branch proposes a behavior that conflicts with the current documented replay and repair contract; source review alone cannot choose whether the external backend contract warrants changing that product invariant.

options.title: Preserve the current invariant
options.body: Reject this branch’s wholesale pruning and request a rebased, evidence-backed fix that keeps completed pairs while addressing the verified protocol failure.

options.title: Approve a narrow native exception
options.body: Define the exact rejected payload shape and upgrade the transcript policy, tests, and implementation together if native Codex truly forbids that historical replay.

recommendation.title: Preserve the current invariant
recommendation.body: Reject this branch’s wholesale pruning and request a rebased, evidence-backed fix that keeps completed pairs while addressing the verified protocol failure.

likelyOwner.reason: Steipete merged the closest native Codex replay-state fix and is the strongest history-backed routing candidate for the replay invariant.
